title: Askeladden som kappåt med trollet
world: Old rural Norway, long ago. A poor old farmer lives with his three sons in a small, low log cottage with a turf roof at the edge of a deep forest of spruce and birch. The troll lives inside a steep, rocky mountain in the middle of the forest, behind a heavy round wooden door. Everything in his home is troll-sized: two iron buckets as big as bathtubs, a huge black iron pot over the fire, a porridge spoon as big as a spade, giant wooden bowls and a long plank table with one long bench. Askeladden's cheese is small, round, soft and white, and fits in his hand. His sack is a small brown linen sack with a drawstring. The brothers' axes are ordinary wood axes with short handles.
palette: Misty autumn in the forest: rust-red and orange birch leaves, dark spruces, golden ferns and cool grey mist drifting between the trunks in soft, pale daylight. Inside the mountain: warm amber firelight on rough brown rock. At home in the cottage: pale daylight through one small window, and in the evening the glow of a single candle.

cast.name: Askeladden
cast.description: Den yngste sønnen, rolig og smart, som møter utfordringer med oppfinnsomhet og en vennlig selvsikkerhet.
cast.look: A small, wiry boy of about eleven, shorter than most boys his age, with a round face, rosy cheeks, bright brown eyes, a button nose, a dark-brown curly mop of hair and a cheeky gap-toothed grin. He wears a moss-green knitted jumper with brown leather elbow patches, dark-brown knee breeches, thick oatmeal-coloured wool stockings and scuffed brown boots. A small brown linen sack with a drawstring hangs from his shoulder.

cast.name: Trollet
cast.description: Skogens store vokter som først virker streng, men lar seg lett imponere og blir mer komisk enn farlig.
cast.look: A giant forest troll, so tall that his head pokes up among the treetops, with cracked, bark-brown skin like an old pine trunk, a shaggy black haystack of hair full of twigs and dry leaves, a potato nose, small twinkly yellow eyes, an enormous mouth that stretches from ear to ear with big square teeth, long dangling arms and a huge, round belly. He wears baggy, patched sackcloth trousers held up by braces of twisted roots, and no shirt.
cast.portrait: Background: misty spruces and rust-red birches.

cast.name: Faren
cast.description: En gammel og sliten bonde som ønsker at sønnene skal arbeide så familien kan klare seg bedre.
cast.look: A short, stocky, bow-legged old farmer of about seventy with a broad, weather-beaten, wrinkled face, a big bulbous nose, small twinkling eyes under shaggy grey eyebrows and a thick, bristly grey beard cut short and square. He wears a battered, wide-brimmed black felt hat, a patched grey-blue wool jacket with horn buttons over a collarless linen shirt, brown knee breeches with braces, grey wool stockings and wooden clogs.

cast.name: Den eldste broren
cast.description: Askeladdens eldste bror, stor og sterk, men så redd for trollet at øksa glipper og han springer hjem.
cast.look: A hulking, broad-shouldered young man of about nineteen with a thick neck, a broad, flat face, a crooked nose, small pale-blue eyes, heavy black eyebrows and short, bristly black hair cropped close to his head. He wears a shaggy, sleeveless sheepskin vest over a rough grey homespun shirt, baggy brown trousers tied under the knees with leather laces, and heavy black boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the edge of the forest by the cottage.

cast.name: Den mellomste broren
cast.description: Askeladdens mellomste bror, som springer så fort fra trollet at lua blir hengende igjen på en grein.
cast.look: A thin, jittery young man of about sixteen with a long neck, a narrow face, a long pointed nose, big worried eyes and frizzy light-brown hair. On his head sits a long, floppy, bright-yellow knitted stocking cap with a blue tassel. He wears a baggy blue linen smock belted with a cord, patched grey trousers and wooden clogs.
cast.portrait: Background: the edge of the forest by the cottage.

places.name: the Troll's Hall
places.look: A big, high room hollowed out of the rock inside the mountain, with rough brown rock walls and thick tree roots poking through the ceiling. A wide stone fireplace glows at one end, with a huge black iron pot hanging over the fire. A long, rough plank table with one long bench stands in front of it, two giant iron buckets stand by a heavy round wooden door, and everything is troll-sized, big and chunky.

cover.prompt: A wide view of a misty autumn forest: the Troll stands among the tall spruces and rust-red birches, so big that his shaggy head pokes up between the treetops, and bends forward to peer down curiously at little Askeladden. Askeladden stands on a mossy boulder at his feet with his small sack over his shoulder, grinning up at him without a trace of fear. Orange leaves drift through the grey mist.
cover.caption: Askeladden møter trollet i skogen, og han er ikke det minste redd.
cover.alt: Et digert troll med brun hud og svart, bustete hår står mellom grantrærne og kikker ned. På en mosegrodd stein står Askeladden og smiler opp til ham.

illustrations.anchor: «... var du aldri redd for troll», sa brødrene i kor.
illustrations.prompt: In the small, low cottage kitchen, by day. The Father stands in the middle of the room with one finger raised high and his chest puffed out, about to boast. On the bench by the wall, the Eldest Brother and the Middle Brother finish his sentence in chorus with bored faces and rolled eyes; the Middle Brother is bareheaded and still out of breath, and neither has his axe. Askeladden sits on the hearthstone by the fire, hugging his knees and grinning. Pale autumn light falls through the small window.
illustrations.caption: «... var du aldri redd for troll», sier brødrene i kor. «Vi vet det.»
illustrations.alt: Faren står midt i stua med fingeren i været. På benken sitter de to storebrødrene og himler med øynene, og ved peisen sitter Askeladden og smiler.

illustrations.prompt: A close view in the misty autumn forest: Askeladden stands with his feet planted wide and squeezes the small round white cheese in his fist, so that milky whey squirts out between his fingers in a big splash. He glares up with a fierce, cheeky frown. The Troll squats down in front of him, his enormous face hanging just above the boy, eyes goggling and his huge mouth dropping open in amazement. His axe leans against a stump; rust-red leaves and grey mist behind them.
illustrations.caption: Skvett! Det spruter ut mellom fingrene til Askeladden.
illustrations.alt: Askeladden klemmer en liten, hvit ost så det spruter ut mellom fingrene. Trollet sitter på huk foran ham og glor med store øyne og åpen munn.

illustrations.anchor: «Disse fingerbølene gidder jeg ikke gå med», sa Askeladden.
illustrations.prompt: In the Troll's Hall, Askeladden stands between the two giant iron buckets, which reach up to his chest, with his arms crossed and his nose in the air, as if they were silly little thimbles. Behind him by the fireplace, the Troll flaps his huge hands in alarm, eyes wide and mouth open in a wail. Warm amber firelight, and the huge black pot hanging over the fire. A medium-wide view.
illustrations.caption: Askeladden later som om de digre jernbøttene bare er noen små fingerbøl.
illustrations.alt: Inne i fjellet står Askeladden med armene i kors mellom to jernbøtter som er så store at han kunne badet i dem. Ved peisen vifter trollet forskrekket med hendene.

illustrations.anchor: Da sekken var full, laget han et lite hull i bunnen med tollekniven.
illustrations.prompt: A low side view at the long plank table in the Troll's Hall, showing both above and below the tabletop: Askeladden sits on the bench with his small sack tied loosely in front of his belly under the table edge and slips a spoonful of porridge into it with an innocent face, while porridge drips out of a little hole in the bottom of the sack into a puddle on the floor. Beside him the Troll shovels porridge from a giant bowl with a spoon as big as a spade, eyes shut in bliss.
illustrations.caption: Én i munnen, to i sekken ... og plopp, plopp, ut på gulvet!
illustrations.alt: Askeladden sitter ved det lange bordet og lar grøten gli ned i en sekk under bordkanten, og grøten drypper ut av et lite hull. Ved siden av ham spiser trollet med en skje så stor som en spade.

illustrations.prompt: Seen from above in the Troll's Hall: the Troll has toppled backwards off the bench and lies on the floor with his belly sticking up like a round hill, kicking his big feet in the air, cheeks puffed and eyes rolling, his giant spoon dropped beside him. Askeladden, still sitting on the bench with a spoon in his hand, leans over and peeks down at him with a cheeky grin. Firelight flickers on the empty bowls on the table. Funny, not scary.
illustrations.caption: BOMS! Trollet velter baklengs ned av benken.
illustrations.alt: Trollet ligger på ryggen på gulvet med den runde magen i været og sparker med beina. Askeladden sitter på benken med skjea i hånda og kikker ned på ham.

illustrations.anchor: Da faren så gullet og sølvet, fikk han så store øyne at han glemte å si «da jeg var ung».
illustrations.prompt: Back home in the small cottage kitchen in the evening, Askeladden tips his small sack over the table, and a glittering stream of gold and silver coins pours out and rolls in all directions. The Father leans over the table with his eyes as big as saucers and his mouth wide open, his hat sliding off the back of his head. Two axes lean against the wall by the door, and a long yellow knitted cap hangs on a peg. Warm candlelight.
illustrations.caption: Faren får så store øyne at han glemmer å si «da jeg var ung».
illustrations.alt: Askeladden heller gull og sølv ut av sekken på bordet hjemme. Faren bøyer seg over bordet med kjempestore øyne og åpen munn.
